import openpyxl

def main():
    in_path = sys.argv[1]
    out_path = sys.argv[2]

    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(in_path)
    data = wb['Data']

    # Collect students whose Performance is "Lowest Performing"
    lowest = []
    for row in data.iter_rows(min_row=2):
        num = row[1].value  # B
        name = row[2].value # C
        perf = row[3].value  # D
        if num is not None and perf == 'Lowest Performing':
            lowest.append((num, name))

    summary = wb['Summary']
    # answer_position is 'Summary'!B3:C68 -> list starts at B3
    start_row = 3
    for i, (num, name) in enumerate(lowest):
        r = start_row + i
        summary.cell(row=r, column=2, value=num)
        summary.cell(row=r, column=3, value=name)

    wb.save(out_path)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()", "path": "/bench/answers/1818/solution.py"}, "name": "write"}
